name: services/examrep2/grader
description: Get exam reports that access token issuer has access
brief_description: Get exam reports that access token issuer has access

arguments.name: only_writable
arguments.description: return only reports that can be edited by access token issuer right now

arguments.name: active_terms_only
arguments.description: return only reports from active academic terms

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of examrep method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.
